apps.short_description: The premium M14/41 (47/40) light tank, the Re.2001 fighter, 7 days of Premium account and Silver Lions - a starter pack for legionnaires in War Thunder!

apps.name: 11 Seconds
apps.short_description: Slide around through puzzle chambers, escaping down to the next floor. Push boxes out of your way. Maybe they can help you. But there's not a lot of time... you need more time!

apps.name: 28 Days Train Wreck Survivor
apps.short_description: A hardcore first-person survival simulator. Explore a wrecked freight train, loot containers, hunt, gather resources, craft weapons and gear, and manage hunger, thirst, fatigue, and warmth to make it through 28 days of cold and predators.

apps.name: 360Hexaworld
apps.short_description: Another world 360Hexaworld is a Web 3.0 metaverse world platform

apps.name: Achievement Clicker 2026 Pro
apps.short_description: Unlock 100 achievements as you smash targets, reduce their health, and upgrade your hammer! Keep clicking, get stronger, and collect them all in Achievement Clicker 2026 Pro!

apps.name: Afterground: The Children
apps.short_description: The world ended. The road home didn't. Fight through ever-changing ruins, build your power one card at a time, and rescue survivors on a journey from grasslands through desert to frozen wastes. A post-apocalyptic action roguelite where every night could be the last.

apps.name: AI Lab Tycoon
apps.short_description: AI Lab Tycoon drops you into the infancy of the AI revolution in 2016. Starting with nothing but a check from a skeptical investor, you'll build an empire of superintelligence over the course of two decades. Can you lead the greatest technological revolution in human history?

apps.name: Aikyam
apps.short_description: Dazzle the hearts of disgruntled villagers with extravagant turn-based battles and rally them against demons in this Bollywood-inspired fantasy RPG!

apps.name: Alpha Spectrum
apps.short_description: Alpha Spectrum is a cyberpunk RPG set in a dystopian 2030, where humanity is dangerously dependent on technology and social media. You are a CIA agent with psionic powers sent to investigate a devastating cyberattack that throws the world into chaos. But the system you trust may crack from within...

apps.name: Another Map Simulator
apps.short_description: Be the architect and the audience of a living, breathing fantasy world. Generate vast procedural maps, paint your empires, and watch as autonomous AI nations wage war, forge alliances, and build deep economies. Intervene as an active god, or sit back and watch centuries of history unfold.

apps.name: Anvil Flow
apps.short_description: Run your own forge in this incremental blacksmithing game. Mine ore, smelt ingots, forge weapons, and sell them to customers. Reinvest your earnings in workers and upgrades, and turn a one-person workshop into an automated production line.

apps.name: Archemyst: Alchemy Shop
apps.short_description: An incremental game of spell-driven gathering and alchemy shopkeeping. Summon skeletons and goblins, gather materials, craft goods and run your shop. Unlock recipes, expand the shop and follow the talent tree to relearn elemental magic and regain your powers as an archmage.

apps.name: Ardenfall
apps.short_description: Inspired by classic The Elder Scrolls games, Ardenfall is a first-person, open-world RPG of ancient cultures and rival factions. Explore windswept plains and forgotten dungeons, forge your path with steel, magic, or persuasion, and shape the fate of those you meet.

apps.name: ARROW ARROW BROKEN
apps.short_description: ARROW ARROW BROKEN is a puzzle game with a typing twist. The rules are the puzzle game you already know, except you must correctly type the arrow written on each block. Get one wrong... and madness will come for you.

apps.name: ART NOIRE: Christmas
apps.short_description: ART NOIRE: Christmas: a relaxing, atmospheric ring puzzle game celebrating Christmas in cities around the world. Rotate concentric rings in 50 picture puzzles. Enjoy festive film noir art, soothing music, and a shift from black and white to full color. Play solo with a mouse.

apps.name: Ashen of Thrones
apps.short_description: When the thrones of men crumble to ash, only Gods and Titans claim the earth. Ashen of Thrones is a visceral 2D RTS featuring intense lane-based combat, mythological evolution, active divine magic, and monumental Titan battles. Command your army and survive the campaign.

apps.name: Astral Planes
apps.short_description: Astral Planes is a psychedelic music puzzler with many solutions. Carve through cosmic dust, chase musical discoveries, and collect notes to build evolving compositions. Every trip transforms the world around you, and every completed performance leaves behind a record of how you played.

apps.name: AstroDiner Manager
apps.short_description: Become a manager for your own diner on a lonely asteroid. Order snacks and drinks, cook dishes, and serve them to quirky alien slimes. Talk, hire, investigate, and keep an eye on the visitors to reveal the hidden mystery behind this place.

apps.name: Astroventure: Unchartred Planet
apps.short_description: Embark on a cosmic journey as Sophia, a brave heroine searching for her lost friend Olga. Explore uncharted worlds, encounter diverse races, and unravel cosmic mysteries. Will you find Olga amidst the depths of space? Battle enemies, solve puzzles, and unlock new realms in this captivating adventure

apps.name: Bad Ice Cream Triple Scoop
apps.short_description: The Ice Creams are BACK! Our legendary arcade classic with over 100M plays is remastered in the ultimate collection. Break ice, outsmart bizarre monsters, and scoop up a victory in a frantic dash for fruit. Remodeled with epic boss battles, new flavors, and 1-4 player co-op!

apps.name: Bamboo Beat
apps.short_description: Embark on a journey through the world of Bamboo Beat. Attack, block, and counter to the beat, and take down one formidable foe after another.

apps.name: Barely Civilized
apps.short_description: Build a floating home, craft a seaplane, and explore an open-world survival crafting sandbox alone or with friends. Tow your workshop and garden across the water to a new coast, fish for dinner, and prepare for winter. Watch your back after dark.

apps.name: BE2
apps.short_description: BE2 is a 2d Jump and run game. the goal in this game is too reach the flag but be careful there can be monster and other  creatures but not that there also exiting levels awaiting for you.

apps.name: Bermuda Bastion
apps.short_description: Survive 33 days in the heart of the Bermuda Triangle! Build triangular structures to defend against malevolent squares, pentagons, and other geometric monsters. In this chaotic city-builder roguelike, every mistake pulls your Bastion closer to the depths.

apps.name: Beyond the Curtains
apps.short_description: "Beyond the Curtains" is a cozy idle game. Watch a town, train journey, or graveyard through a window. Click to interact, press "nap" to move time, or simply observe. No tutorials, no goals—witness changes across three themes and piece together their stories.

apps.name: BitLoaf
apps.short_description: Little 3D Loafs live on your Windows desktop. They wander, react to you, hang out with each other, and find their own fun while you work. Even secret characters! With more to come with updates.

apps.name: Black Dawn Rises
apps.short_description: The action game where you write the orders. Sign tomorrow's order as written or change it, then fight the mission your choice made: free-flow combat, a whip that binds, and Iona Sorn at your side. Since 1947, secret files have said what happens next. Arena co-op for two, on one couch or online.

apps.name: BlackHole Defence
apps.short_description: You are the black hole. Pull in matter, gain mass and grow while your attacks keep the battlefield moving. Turn a small singularity into the centre of a cosmic battle.

apps.name: Blast_Mining_Puzzle
apps.short_description:
Swap bombs, match three, and dig deep underground in this match-3 mining puzzle. 
Sell ores, upgrade your bombs, and keep digging — many more upgrade systems lie buried in the depths.

apps.name: Block Party Apocalypse
apps.short_description: A blocky third-person zombie shooter for 1–4 players. Fight 30 waves across three days of the outbreak, stack upgrade cards, grab miniguns and flamethrowers from supply drops, and reach the last evacuation helicopter out of Port Haven.

apps.name: Bloodrust
apps.short_description: Bloodrust is a minimalist, old-school first-person dungeon crawler. Lead a party of four Ferric Wardens into the Ashwoods to clear the Blood Rust; a curse that spreads through metal and turns the world wrong.

apps.name: Boat Trip
apps.short_description: Pilot your boat through swarming schools of fish in this naval action roguelite. Combine weapons, upgrade your ship and face colossal bosses, solo or in 1~4 online co-op.

apps.name: BogKnight
apps.short_description: A broken sword, a talking raven, and a city preserved beneath the mist. Explore a nonlinear dark fantasy action-adventure of wraiths, swordplay, and strange magic. Find your own way through the bog.

apps.name: Booba Milk Tea
apps.short_description: An unique dual deckbuilding sex battle roguelite. Build two decks, a normal deck and a lust deck. As your Lust rises you start drawing more cards from your more powerful lust deck. But pace yourself! If the lust deck runs out it's game over!

apps.name: Boxing Tycoon
apps.short_description: Run your own boxing promotion. Scout and sign fighters, negotiate every contract, face the press, build fight cards and beat rival promoters to the biggest nights. Watch your fighters go to war in full 3D and turn them into world champions.

apps.name: BRAZUELA
apps.short_description: Start from nothing and build your own path in Brazuela, a political and life simulator set in Brazil. Work, study, join a political party, run for office, win positions of power, and take part in the decisions that shape a city.

apps.name: Brickrium
apps.short_description: Keep watering one brick on a window shelf and watch. Droplets bead up, run down and pool in the dish as moss, small yellow flowers, ferns and mushrooms slowly grow. Outside, the hour and weather change and rain runs down the glass. No winning, score or timer. Time passes while the game is closed.

apps.name: Broke2Blocks: Crypto Mining Simulator
apps.short_description: Start in your parents' basement with a single USB stick miner. Plug in every cable yourself and sell your coins. Move into an old gym, then into a huge warehouse full of racks. Buy broken miners on the black market, fix them screw by screw and keep the heat under control.

apps.name: Bunny Beats
apps.short_description: Bunny Beats is a listening first rhythm learning game with procedurally generated rhythms. Each bunny swings its mochi hammer with a distinct rhythm; master the rhythms on the fly to make the best mochi for the moon goddess!

apps.name: CANON CANON CANON
apps.short_description: Stack cannons on your units, chain their effects and hold the line! A roguelite lane defense where every run is different.

apps.name: Carouspell
apps.short_description: Carouspell is a dark fantasy roguelite bullet heaven where you wield revolving magic to slay hordes of monsters. Spin your Spell Chamber, collect ancient relics and assemble god-slaying combinations to survive the deepest pits of despair.

apps.name: Carry Crew
apps.short_description: "There’s room for one more!" Pick your cargo, pile it onto a board, and grab opposite ends in this couch co-op adventure for two. When the ice cracks underfoot, jump together on three. You both made it across. Did your cargo?

apps.name: Castles Of War
apps.short_description: A side-scrolling real-time strategy game of conquest, courage, and creation. Raise armies, command formations, and fight across hand-crafted pixel battlefields in a war-torn fantasy world.

apps.name: CCR - Cosmic Card Realm
apps.short_description: CCR is a free-to-play online collection game where every draw brings a new discovery. Complete card sets, forge them into unique Relics, and build a museum that grows with you. With no battles or competitive pressure, you can relax, draw a few cards each day, and enjoy collecting for years.

apps.name: Chess Nuke
apps.short_description: This is NOT a Chess, don't aim to CHECKMATE, but focus on MERGING the pieces to become a NUCLEAR BOMB

apps.name: CHEW YOUR FOOD
apps.short_description: It didn't chew you properly. Escape its stomach by crawling, solving puzzles, listening carefully, and avoiding monsters in this survival horror.

apps.name: CHI Project
apps.short_description: Sci-fi fantasy visual novel, turn-based RPG, and murder mystery -- all in one!

apps.name: Clarity's Calling
apps.short_description: Uncover your deepest ambitions in CLARITY'S CALLING, a narrative-driven puzzle game. Navigate dimly lit mazes and solve slide puzzles to lead Claire through her journey of self-discovery.

apps.name: Coaches Box 27
apps.short_description: Take charge of an Australian rules football club. Trade, draft and game plan your way to a premiership. Make tactical changes from the box, manage your squad and make the hard decisions to build your dynasty. Play singleplayer or multiplayer with up to 8 friends.

apps.name: Come Pick Me Up
apps.short_description: Your sister texts you from a hospital after visiting hours. She needs you to pick her up. Search the wards, follow her messages, examine belongings and piece together unsettling records in this first-person psychological horror game.

apps.name: Conversation Simulator
apps.short_description: Conversation Simulator is the practice tool for interviews, negotiations, difficult talks, and language skills. AI characters run entirely on your computer. No internet needed during play. Open source, fairly priced.

apps.name: Cool Bandit
apps.short_description: Explore the shifting depths of Grenopolis in this stylized 2D top-down action shooter. Face relentless zombie hordes, manage high-tension progression, and team up in intense online co-op to survive together in an underground world that constantly evolves.

apps.name: CORD:EX MAGIAS
apps.short_description: A deckbuilding roguelite where your hand is the puzzle. Weave your cards into Cores and unleash combo attacks. Explore a 2.5D world and meet every telegraphed strike head-on until it BREAKs. When hearts resonate, strike as one with up to five companions and face the truth at the end of five tales.

apps.name: Cosmic Inferno
apps.short_description: Explore 100 star systems, battle pirates, trade, mine asteroids, and salvage wrecks. Buy and customize spaceships, upgrade your weapons, and chart your own course. Your onboard computer A.R.E.S. is always by your side. Whether you like it or not.

apps.name: Crypt Survivor
apps.short_description: Fight through a cursed crypt in this action roguelite. Master unique classes, combine powerful upgrades, and claim the abilities of fallen bosses. Battle across five deadly floors to break the curse, or push your build to its limit in Endless Mode.

apps.name: Cube Arena
apps.short_description: A PvP arena fighter to play with or against your friends, on PC and VR. Fight with swords or magic, burn and bomb each other, and outplay the other team across multiple game modes.

apps.name: Cubic Blitz
apps.short_description: Cubic Blitz is an isometric puzzle game where you control a cube and solve loads of hand-crafted levels. With the power of paint, sponges, and much more, your task is simple: PAINT THE WORLD.

apps.name: Cyber Rail
apps.short_description: Cyber Rail is a frenetic roguelike FPS with robot cowboys, speedy parkour, and devastating synergies.  Grapple, slide, and swing as you hunt down enemy bandits on your flying train.

apps.name: Dacan Express: Logistic manager
apps.short_description: Manage a high-stakes logistics depot where the hardest route to navigate is the human one. Negotiate ruthless contracts with e-shops, handle headstrong couriers on the brink of strikes, and build a delivery empire in a gritty management sim where every personality has a price.

apps.name: Dark Workshop Simulator
apps.short_description: A first-person dark fantasy shop simulator where the customers bite. Stock shelves, set prices and let the grime build up. Trace sigils to brew potions and forge blades, ride out plagues and wars that upend the market, and keep a hammer under the counter.

apps.name: DarkPath
apps.short_description: DarkPath is a roguelike action game where every run brings new challenges. Explore procedurally generated maps, fight randomized enemies, collect powerful items, and shape your build. Discover mysterious objects, encounters, and rewards as you venture deeper into the dark paths of DarkPath

apps.name: Darts RPG
apps.short_description: An RPG set in northern England. Play darts. Aim high. Win the league. Save yourself from total destitution, one lukewarm pint at a time.

apps.name: Death Casino
apps.short_description: DEATH CASINO is an adrenaline-pumping blend of tabletop strategy and Russian Roulette. Duel the deranged Glassman in an ever-escalating battle of speed and wit, where each round brings in more mayhem and strategy to master. Shoot, stab, and drink your way out of the Death Casino!

apps.name: Desecrated Deck
apps.short_description: Desecrated Deck is a first-person psychological horror card game where you face a spectral opponent in a forbidden occult ritual of Rock, Paper, Scissors, powerful Item Cards, and supernatural Perks. Win the game — or discover what happens when you don’t.

apps.name: Desktop Buddy
apps.short_description: Desktop buddy is an active sandbox companion game where you can paint, shoot, crush and decorate your very own ragdoll on your desktop. Use familiar paint tools to fully customize your desktop buddy to your liking so you can treat it well, or don't.

apps.name: Desktop Car Dealer
apps.short_description: A tiny used-car lot that lives right above your taskbar. Buy junkers, fix them up, haggle with customers and sell. Make smart calls, hire staff, and turn a run-down roadside lot into a dealership that runs itself.

apps.name: DesktopDaily
apps.short_description: Ami Koharune and Tsukuyomi-chan live on your PC. Chat with voiced characters whose gestures match their words, or watch them cook, read and sleep in a shared home that doubles as a live wallpaper. Free to download, with trial credits for chat.

apps.name: Destiny Is Dice
apps.short_description:
A dungeon of chaos determined by a few dice rolls.
The only one you can rely on here is Grin, the witch who rules the all of this place.
She’ll gladly rig the dice for you. Use this to create options that never existed before and build the strongest team!
Until, one day, you no longer need her help.

apps.name: Devil inc.
apps.short_description: Devil inc. is a strategy simulation of the conflict between good and evil. Explore the development of civilizations, society’s weaknesses and the consequences of your decisions. Watch how your choices change the world.

apps.name: Devil's Work
apps.short_description: Do the Devil's dirty work by harvesting souls for the underworld as you fight to survive enemy hordes in this first-person shooter.

apps.name: Digital Paintball Redux
apps.short_description: A return to form for Digital Paintball with upgraded textures, sounds, menus, maps and more! This is the definitive way to experience the mod that captivated an entire community of Paintball enthusiasts.

apps.name: Dino Haven
apps.short_description: Cozy up with prehistoric pals!  Give them snacks and food to keep them happy! All while you create a stunning safe haven for them to thrive in!

apps.name: Diofru: Survivors of the Tower
apps.short_description: Awaken from a lowly apprentice into one of nine elemental archmages and climb 50 floors of the tower. Kill the epic monster before the floor's clock hits zero, or the ceiling comes down while you fight. Reroll and banish your level-ups, and grow the village below the tower between climbs.

apps.name: Diventare Premier
apps.short_description: Italian-style satirical visual novel. You play Maddalena: 26, boundless political ambition and an arrhythmic heart that won't cooperate. Every choice counts, in a Brianza of favours, aperitivi and late trains. Build your career while trying not to die of a heart attack.

apps.name: Donut
apps.short_description: A quick, cheeky trick-taking card game. Everyone starts with points and races to zero by winning tricks, but finish a hand without a single trick and you eat a donut: five points back on. Play bots, a six-venue campaign, or friends online with a party code.

apps.name: Dr Dick Dong: Stripper Underworld
apps.short_description: DRDD: Dr Dick Dong is an adult action RPG. Go deep undercover as Dixon Hard, hunting a lost agent through a city drenched in satire, with street brawls, B-movie cheese, X-rated hookups, and a phone you can doomscroll on instead of doing your job.

apps.name: Dragon Riddler
apps.short_description: This is not a word game. It’s a heroic fantasy adventure powered by dynamic word‑based systems that blend the adventurer’s abilities with the player’s skill.

apps.name: Dual Cultivation: Sword Immortal Chronicles
apps.short_description: Dual Cultivation: Sword Immortal Chronicles is a male-oriented xianxia romance adventure game. Explore the martial world, meet unique female cultivators, grow stronger through cultivation, unlock character stories and intimate interactions, and embark on a journey of dual cultivation.

apps.name: Duat: Beyond Light & Shadow
apps.short_description: The mystical Egyptian underworld beckons you in Duat: Beyond Light & Shadow! Foil the plans of Set and Apep using your powers of light. Explore the varied environments of the underworld and battle your way through in this epic pixel art style Metroidvania.

apps.name: Dungeon Town Life
apps.short_description: Your Adventure, Your Dungeon, Your Home! A cozy 3D anime dungeon crawler with village life. Fight through dungeons by day, then return to forge weapons, grow healing herbs, brew potions and decorate your home. Play solo or with friends.

apps.name: DUNK
apps.short_description: A first-person 1-6 player basketball game where every physics-based pass, block, and DUNK comes down to skill. Hit unique courts across the universe, hang out over proximity chat, or finesse your 1st-person skills in solo play. Unlock new looks, emotes, and more, to flex on your mates!

apps.name: Dyeversion
apps.short_description: Dyeversion is a color-routing tower defense. Drag liquid hoses from color sources to your towers, mix colors to forge powerful COMBO towers, and route your pipes around the enemy path. Battle dozens of levels, earn tokens, and unlock a deep skill tree.

apps.name: Echoes From The Past
apps.short_description: Return to your childhood home. In this psychological first-person horror game, a cassette recorder brings past events back to life through sound—and changes the present. Follow the echoes, solve puzzles, and uncover a family secret buried long ago.

apps.name: EDEN FRONTIER
apps.short_description: Lead crash survivors on a hostile planet in this survival colony builder. Secure oxygen, water, food and power. Research new technology, send expeditions and face your residents' demands. Every resource—and every decision—shapes the home you build.

apps.name: EmbeRogue
apps.short_description: EmbeRogue is a real roguelike: turn-based, grid-based and boom-based, where everything can burn. Make your escape or tame your inner flames to defeat the FireLords.

apps.name: Embral
apps.short_description: A roguelike bullet heaven about an elephant defending a sacred tree from a forest fire. Aim, dodge enemy attacks, and upgrade your elephant after every wave.

apps.name: Epic Loads: A Hero's Wish
apps.short_description: Spend a jolly day with Prince Hiro, and help him prepare for the holiday festivities!

apps.name: Esports Career Simulator 2027
apps.short_description: A deep esports career simulator: from a day job and training at your PC to tournaments, transfers, sponsors and the title of world champion. Choose your discipline, level up your skills, make tough decisions and build your own team.

apps.name: F-2 MISSIONS: CASE ONE
apps.short_description: A physics-based flight sim with authentic handling: the JASDF's F-2 over a true-to-scale Japan. As a rookie on a special course, train from takeoffs to valley runs, formation, refueling and US carrier traps, then fly alert scrambles and ops training against simulated SAMs. On a monitor or in VR.

apps.name: Fear, But Stupid
apps.short_description: A first-person horror game with dark humor and PS2-style vibes. Solve puzzles, find keys and clues, avoid enemies, and escape each level using only your flashlight and your wits. Short but intense experiences with gore, parody, and pure tension.

apps.name: Festival Fireworks Simulator
apps.short_description: Whenever you want fireworks, the night sky is ready. Click to launch a burst, write a wish across the sky, or build a whole show from the very first shell. Holidays, birthdays and ordinary evenings all deserve a fireworks show.

apps.name: Fever Tilt
apps.short_description: Fever Tilt is a fast 1v1 zero-G arena where you mine gems, weaponize drifting debris, and sabotage your opponent with lasers, forcefields, and explosives. Procedural arenas and physics-driven chaos make every 3–7 minute match a ruthless fight to score first.

apps.name: Find The Needle Together
apps.short_description: Millions of straws, one needle. Dig through giant haystacks with up to 3 friends in online co-op with proximity voice chat, sell the hay, then build belts and machines that dig for you. Find all 24 hidden needles for your Pincushion.

apps.name: Fish Them All!
apps.short_description: Aim for 100 million fish! Catch fish, earn money, and unlock skills as your hauls grow and your fishing speeds up. Recruit divers, drones, and UFOs in this short pixel-art incremental fishing game, and reel in the very last fish in 4–5 hours.

apps.name: Fishing Fever
apps.short_description: An incremental roguelike fishing game. Start with one tool, end with five. Draft, upgrade and stack them, then hunt 75 species across eight oceans until the whole sea is biting at once. Rivals steal your cards. Something in the dark already knows your name. One more round. Always one more round.

apps.name: Five Nights with the Boys
apps.short_description: What starts as a simple house-sitting job quickly becomes a nightmare. Watch over four friends hosting a week-long "peak function" as their increasingly disturbing behavior turns five nights into a desperate fight for survival. Manage your limited resources and survive until 6 AM.

apps.name: Flesh Blossom
apps.short_description: Play as Doctor Parsnip Green, treating horrifically beautiful illnesses in this Victorian-inspired investigative point-and-click. How far will you go to save the ones you love — and who will still trust you when your sanity begins to crack?

apps.name: Fogline
apps.short_description: FOGLINE is a first-person survival horror game where every shadow hides danger. Explore abandoned locations, solve puzzles, fight terrifying zombies, and survive a city consumed by horror. Armed with limited hope and your weapons, can you escape the nightmare alive?

apps.name: Fractal Descent
apps.short_description: Drop from your spaceship into hostile procedural planets. Mine valuable ore, battle enemies, redirect deadly hazards, build destructive weapon combinations, and extract your haul before the depths overwhelm you.

apps.name: Fruit Store Simulator
apps.short_description: Stock it, price it, sell it, and turn a small corner fruit shop into the neighborhood's favorite fruit store.

apps.name: FUTURE AXIS BATTLE
apps.short_description:
Dive into the captivating sights and sounds of the digital landscape of this new arcade puzzle game.
Push the blocks to create combinations and avoid being crushed.
Game features Single-player, Local PvP and Local PvE modes

apps.name: Gatehopper2D
apps.short_description: Gatehopper 2D is a fast-paced faction-based multiplayer top-down 2D space shooter. Pilot customizable starships across interconnected sectors, battle rival factions (Octane, Solstorm, Qwantzy), capture beacons & flags, and mine ore in a living galaxy.

apps.name: GearGrave
apps.short_description:
2D side-scrolling strategy game.
Spawn units, fight, and destroy. Your choices decide victory or defeat.

apps.name: Ghost Transmission
apps.short_description: Ghost Transmission is a technohorror survival game for 1–4 players. Investigate haunted locations, gather evidence, and seal the entity before it gets inside you.

apps.name: Ghost//Root
apps.short_description: Enter a locked network through one surviving terminal. Read conflicting records, question witnesses, and use recovered programs to uncover why an autonomous machine refused its orders. A retro terminal mystery in four acts, with six endings shaped by your decisions.

apps.name: GHOSTPUNCH
apps.short_description: GHOSTPUNCH is the horror game where the monster is you. Get stronger every run with unique items, discover powerful abilities, master an expressive combat system and take back your house!

apps.name: Goblin God
apps.short_description: In Goblin God, you rule a tribe of chaotic goblins! Build villages, defend against evil humans, and unleash divine powers to shape the world (or cause mayhem). Each island brings new challenges—will you lead your goblins to glory or just enjoy the chaos?

apps.name: Godless Dawn
apps.short_description: Godless Dawn is a ruthless action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Descend into cursed dungeons, uncover the stories behind fallen souls, and reveal the truth hidden behind the silence of the gods.

apps.name: Golden Town Card Shop
apps.short_description: Run a fantasy card shop and venture into dungeons with a deck of your own. Bring sealed cards home to appraise, then choose what to collect, display, or sell. Turn your earnings into a better shop and prepare for your next adventure.

apps.name: Greed Forest TD
apps.short_description: Build huge mazes, combine towers for wild synergies, discover ridiculous spells and upgrades, and turn your Buildy into a baddie.

apps.name: Greena
apps.short_description: Your uncle stopped answering his phone. Tonight you drive out to his farm at the end of a valley road, through a storm that won't move on. A short first-person horror game with a PS1 look.

apps.name: GRIDWORKS
apps.short_description: Found a power company and keep a growing city's lights on. Build generators, string the wires, survive storms and meltdowns, and climb from a single solar panel to fusion and a nation-wide grid. The grid must grow.

apps.name: Grim Dice
apps.short_description: Dark medieval times. Face off in an online PvP Farkle-like duel where dice combos become damage and greed can cost you victory. Choose a hero, collect items, and defeat your opponent. Risk, strategy, and luck decide who survives.

apps.name: Guild of Champions
apps.short_description: Run an esports organization on the road to Worlds. Sign and trade pro players, set the lineup and training, then draft and command your team in live 5v5 arena matches, or simulate them. Manage money, morale and chemistry season after season.

apps.name: HadalLine
apps.short_description: 事故で孤立した深海施設。頼れるのは通信室のチャット画面だけ——応答できる生存者は3人。返事を待たずに流れていく。夜ごとに決めるのは、限られた電力をどの区画に回すか。届く言葉は少しずつ記録と食い違う。矛盾を証拠に変えるテキストアドベンチャー。

apps.name: Hagyo-gil: The Way Home
apps.short_description: You simply fell asleep, bored of studying as usual. But when you opened your eyes, you were trapped in a school where the same day repeats. No friends, no teachers. Only things that used to be your friends roam the corridors. Gather supplies, survive, and find a way out.

apps.name: Hallowed Veil: The Last Prince
apps.short_description: As the last knight of a fallen order, uncover the dark secrets of a once-vibrant world now shrouded in corruption. In this Action adventure game explore haunting ruins, castles, caves, and forests, battling twisted creatures born of an insidious curse. Free Elythar from darkness, or embrace it.

apps.name: Haoru: Desktop Chaos
apps.short_description: A chibi anime girl moves onto your real Windows desktop: she keeps you company while you work, reads, naps and plays on your windows, and wrecks everything on screen with 27 over-the-top weapons and 15 pranks. Dress her up, build an island village, befriend Kitsune and Neko. Only pixels get hurt.

apps.name: Haze of Lucidity (Halu) - The Phoenix
apps.short_description: A psychological horror game about Annie, a nurse working at an old hospital. After caring for an elderly patient, strange events begin to unfold. Explore the hospital, uncover its mysteries, and discover the truth behind what is happening.

apps.name: Her in the Abyss
apps.short_description: You accidentally intercept a distress signal from space—a girl codenamed C804 is venturing alone into a forbidden zone. Game time runs in perfect real-time sync with reality; every response, every silence, shapes her actions and decisions.

apps.name: Heroic Gambit
apps.short_description: Heroic Gambit is an action roguelite set in the fantastic world of Nemia. Navigate the randomly generated dungeons, through progressively more challenging foes, traps and riddles of the Founders. Good reflexes and solid strategy are required to reach your ultimate goal.

apps.name: Heroswarm
apps.short_description: A tower defense where heroes hold the road. Mix fire, frost, lightning and holy against five armour classes, draft rules that change the run, and face waves that adapt to your defense. Build your own maps in the Map Maker, then defend them, alone or online with a friend.

apps.name: Hide The Corpse
apps.short_description:
Hide Gus before the cops arrive in this chaotic VR physics sandbox. Drag, throw, and cram a fully simulated body into absurd hiding spots across unique environments while the clock ticks down. 
Includes the Gusimir Mansion DLC.

apps.name: Hostile Systems
apps.short_description: A space strategy game with roguelite and tower defense elements. Draw a trade route, a fleet formation, a cannon line or a minefield, and watch it fill in. Build an economy and defend it against enemy fleets and super bosses. Minimalist on the outside, complex on the inside. Solo or with friends.

apps.name: How to Train Your Spirit: The Exorcism of a Busty Ghost
apps.short_description:
Set in the Edo period, you are the last Onmyoji, called to an eerie estate for an exorcism.
The source is a lewd, busty female spirit.
As the final master of a forbidden art, your goal is to bring spirits to climax and purify them.
Yet this one feels different… a hidden truth lies beneath.

apps.name: How We Die: Prologue
apps.short_description: Pack your bag with good tools, modify your character's dice, and reach the end of the story.

apps.name: Hushound
apps.short_description: You are blind. You see only through sound: every noise sends out a wave that draws the world in light, then fades. The creature hunting you is blind too. It hears what you do and sees what your waves reveal. To see, you have to make noise.

apps.name: I, TANK
apps.short_description: The machines have taken over the world. Blast them all with WW2-era tanks and take back our cities, with heavy metal playing in the Background. A stylized survivors-like with interesting mechanics. Play with historic tanks such as the T-34 or the Tiger 1, or make your own tank in the workshop.

apps.name: Imperium Eternal
apps.short_description: Immerse yourself in the ultimate real-time strategy war game where all of human history is at your command. Create powerful empires across all eras on a scale never seen before.

apps.name: Incoherence: Dark Rooms
apps.short_description: You awaken in a strange yet familiar room with multiple doors, with no memory of how you got there. As you explore, you discover this place you are trapped in is built from interconnected rooms drawn from your own memories. To escape, you'll need to uncover the truth, before it consumes you...

apps.name: Infinite Flow
apps.short_description: You are a different kind of chicken that wants to leave the fence that binds you.

apps.name: Insertion Burn
apps.short_description: A real-time tactical space fleet simulation. Plan orbital maneuvers and intercept windows, track contacts across multiple sensors, coordinate your weapons and defenses, and defeat the enemy within the physical limits of propellant, power, and heat.

apps.name: Instant Auction
apps.short_description: Instant photos, instant auction. Hunt for the best shot around the auction house, then watch it go under the hammer. Every photo hides its true value, so every bid is a gamble. Bluff, read the room and use tools to trip up rivals. An online party game for 3–6 players.

apps.name: JETLINE
apps.short_description: A jet-powered roadster with a suction fan, loose in all of Budapest. Grab a wall and ride it up to the roof, backflip over spike strips, lose the police in the back streets, and race across the real city, by night or by day.

apps.name: Jetski TD
apps.short_description: Race against your friends in this PvP tower defense. Build and upgrade towers, ride your Monkey Jetski to haul gold from fish nodes, help other players defend — or quietly make things worse. First to clear a wave sets the pace for everyone.

apps.name: JOOCOURT
apps.short_description: JOOCOURT – психологічна point-and-click пригода з романтикою та кількома фіналами. Артистка Джу приїжджає в загадкове місто, де кожен має свою роль. Чи зможе вона бути почутою, не почавши грати когось іншого? Гра за мотивами реп-альбому JOOZAIJOO «IN DA GAME».

apps.name: Junkyard Crew
apps.short_description: Grab your fishbowl-headed friends and clean up a mountain of junk! Bag it, toss it into the crusher and sell the bales to Frank, then build conveyor belts, claw robots and monster trucks to do it faster. Watch grass, flowers and life return as your crew clears the yard.

apps.name: Just Fly
apps.short_description: A cozy-adrenaline wingsuit game with no forced goals. Explore procedural sky islands with forests, canyons, tunnels and dangerous caves. Weave between trees, hot air balloons and wind turbine blades, and score points with high-speed proximity flying. No timers, no goals, epic crashes. Just fly.

apps.name: Kaperfahrt
apps.short_description: Sail an open Caribbean where every choice matters. Plunder ships in fierce naval battles, trade between rival houses, and build yourself from a humble sloop into a feared legend. Kaperfahrt is your pirate sandbox on a grand scale.

apps.name: Keep Drawing: Webtoon Tycoon
apps.short_description: Start as a solo webtoon artist and build a studio empire. Draw chapters readers love, grow hit series, hire specialists, and negotiate publishing deals across a 25-year career. A cozy creative journey with the depth of a management tycoon.

apps.name: KickingBottle
apps.short_description: One bottle, two sides. Play hide-and-seek for 2–8 players across Bellfair Town and Tide Harbor. Slip past the defender, kick the bottle over, or risk a teammate rescue. Pick from three capture modes or learn the ropes in solo practice.

apps.name: Kinfall: An Idle Dungeon Crawler
apps.short_description: An idle dungeon crawler that plays beside your work. Your family of heroes dives, fights and loots on its own. Take over at any moment. When a hero falls for good, an heir carries on with the family's gifts and legends. You make the important decisions, the hero fights for you.

apps.name: Knit Knit Tidy Up Together
apps.short_description: Start your adventure by gathering the 20,000 colorful yarns scattered across the floor! Wind them onto the correct spools to clear the mess, then use the spooled yarn to knit the store's clothes from scratch, stitch by stitch.

apps.name: L.E.O.
apps.short_description: L.E.O. is a first-person shooter with 4v4 matches between police and private military contractors. Customize your weapons and armor, take on bots offline, or team up as police to bring a hostage out alive.

apps.name: Late Shift - Midnight Burger
apps.short_description: A cozy horror game where you own and manage a burger shop. Prepare burger, serve customers, and survive the midnight nightmare.

apps.name: Launch Hazard
apps.short_description: Launch Hazard is a single-player physics score attack game. Send a rocket-powered athlete crashing through arenas, steer mid-crash to chain targets, and complete objectives to score higher and earn better ranks in 90-second runs.

apps.name: Legend of the Corndog(s)
apps.short_description: Finding yourself out of food, you decide to venture into the outdoors for the first time in an embarrassingly long time in order to satiate your growing hunger.

apps.name: Life Origins
apps.short_description: Life Origins is a co-op dinosaur extraction game where your loot carrier is alive. Explore with friends, collect a haul with your Dinono companion, and try to get everyone out when prehistoric danger turns your plan into chaos.

apps.name: Linglong Duel
apps.short_description: A two-player strategy board game of Chinese craftsmanship. Gather precious materials, build workshops, and outwit your rival as the court’s clock advances. Compete for commissions and imperial patrons. Play solo, share a device, or challenge a friend online.

apps.name: Loot profit
apps.short_description: Merchant Simulator. It seems simple enough — buy low, sell high. But in this world, almost everyone’s out to swindle each other...

apps.name: Lost Gateways
apps.short_description: The world beyond the gate is rolled fresh for every soul — ring after ring of wilds, delves, and buried gold, each one deadlier than the last. Take a contract, read the map, bring a shovel. Bring friends: everyone gets their own loot, and nobody fights over a chest.

apps.name: LSDos: Digital Simulation Simulator
apps.short_description: LSDos is a weirdcore-inspired, open-world exploration game where you are trapped in a computer, searching for any way to escape. Complete tasks and do an abundance of things to acquire the tools and expertise needed to leave safely.

apps.name: Magic Might
apps.short_description: You are the only apprentice at the Starlight Academy who never showed a school's sigil. A space spell gone wrong throws you across the sea to an unknown land of ten regions and nearly 80 dungeons. A voxel spell-evolution roguelite: dodge on the move, cast when you stand still.

apps.name: Maglev Driver
apps.short_description: Drive Japan’s superconducting maglevs at up to 603 km/h. Break speed records, run timetabled passenger services, handle emergencies at speed, or head out trackside as a spotter.

apps.name: Mana Boom
apps.short_description: Magic meets physics, and the world is yours to mess with! Battle or race with up to 8 players in real time. Lob spells with your choice of elements and projectile behaviors, swing on ropes, and destroy or create terrain. Win your own way. Play dirty, but don't let it backfire!

apps.name: Mana League
apps.short_description: Fast 7v7 fantasy football with dwarves, orcs, goblins and a lot more. Curl it, chip it or fire a Zigzag Bolt past the keeper. Cast Team Spells, dodge mine carts and play with up to 4 friends on couch co-op or online.

apps.name: Matelotes
apps.short_description: The Royal Hen has disappeared! Lead a group of enthusiastic (though unqualified) sailors on a quest for glory, riches, and, as fate would have it, poultry. Visit a variety of islands, resolve political conflicts, and upgrade your boat in this narrative adventure game inspired by RPGs.

apps.name: MECCHA LIAR
apps.short_description: 2 to 4 participants gathered in pursuit of a massive cash prize. The moment they open their eyes, they are trapped in unfamiliar darkness and each other's lies. In a place where no one can be trusted, only one can survive.

apps.name: Mecha Force
apps.short_description: Mecha Force is a first-person 3D action game that blends mecha elements with Roguelite features. You will act as the "Correlator", customizing and piloting your dedicated giant mech "Kylin" to stand against the alien invaders known as "Dominators", protect Earth, and reclaim humanity's future.

apps.name: mechakucha pakurion
apps.short_description: Multiplayer hide‑and‑seek party game featuring painting systems, fully customisable match rules and unique special abilities including clone power（kagebunshin）,optical‑camouflage(kougakumeisai 2620). Play with friends and compete across varied modes.

apps.name: Mechanic and Healing Girl
apps.short_description: Nineteen-year-old Aaron Tekin was reborn from the brink of death in a repair shop and gained the ability to control machinery. He came to the college and befriended three mature female tutors, but was caught in a crisis due to a mysterious signal and had to protect them.

apps.name: Meltdown Acres
apps.short_description: Buy cheap land inside the Zone, grow vegetables that change whoever eats them, and sell them to customers who should know better. A dark comedy farming game about a hopeful young farmer, a four-eyed goat, and a harvest nobody can explain.

apps.name: Messy Room Princess ~Reform or Ruin H-Simulation~
apps.short_description: An intimate simulation game with a reclusive girl, featuring all hand-drawn pixel animations. Play as a housekeeper and raise her affection through conversation and touch! Your choices lead to either a "Redemption" or "Corruption" route. Customize scenes in "Gallery Mode"!

apps.name: Metro Builder
apps.short_description: Run the transit company of a real city. Sixteen cities from Istanbul to Chicago, built from real maps: draw metro, tram and ferry lines, tunnel under rivers and straits, and keep millions moving through rush hours, strikes, breakdowns and City Hall.

apps.name: Midnight Seven
apps.short_description: Read her habits. Read her hand. Play seven-card stud against nine adult rivals, build bonds, and face private finales. Chase token combos in After Hours, or team up for a three-hand cup. A single-player casino with virtual chips and a memory for the way you play.

apps.name: Milky Egg Ranch
apps.short_description: Raise some little yellow creatures on your desktop o_o… Buy Milky Eggs, hatch Milky Spirits of varying rarities, earn Milkoins, expand your facilities, and build a wealthy Milky Egg ranch!

apps.name: Moeka: Exposure’s Temptation
apps.short_description: Live out Moeka’s hidden exhibitionist desires in a 3D anime experience. Push your limits in public, gain confidence, and unlock new challenges… all while staying one step away from being caught.

apps.name: Moji Snake
apps.short_description: Fight to survive this snake roguelike with quick adventures or endless runs.

apps.name: Monster Gals - Dating Simulator
apps.short_description: Awaken in a terrifying world where monsters are real, find a way back home while forging bonds with five captivating monster gals: a playful gecko, a mischievous demon, a popular pumpkin, a elegant carnivorous plant and a gentle moth. Shape friendships and romances in this light-hearted adventure!

apps.name: Mool: Chroma
apps.short_description: A top-down roguelite where you are the monster. Absorb colors, mix them into impossible forms, and tear down the "heroes" who farmed your kind. Nine apex awakenings, hand-built rooms dealt fresh every run, and an altar that trades your curses for power.

apps.name: Moto Mouse Stunt Mania
apps.short_description: Ride, flip and wheelie a daredevil mouse through 30 physics stunt levels. Lean to land your jumps, earn three stars on every track and unlock 8 bikes with coins earned by playing. Full controller support. No ads, no in-game purchases.
developers: Enaayah Software Development and Services Private Limited
publishers: Enaayah Software Development and Services Private Limited

apps.name: MR MAGEBOY
apps.short_description:
A cozy incremental game about an aspiring mage opening a Rescue Ranch for lost Familiars.
Gather resources, upgrade your spells, explore biomes, and turn a profit to help your village thrive.

apps.name: My Retro World
apps.short_description: Build the retro world of your dreams: from chill vaporwave vibes to neon retrowave skylines, from 90s suburbs to futuristic cityscapes, all in the most nostalgic sandbox...

apps.name: My Summer, Your Silence
apps.short_description: Linus thought a new city could leave the past behind. But summer lingers: a heartbeat sounds in the woods, an old school lies beneath the water, and a girl says she has been waiting for him. A story-driven visual novel of school days, surreal repetition, and buried memories.

apps.name: Nano Reef
apps.short_description: Turn every keystroke into a thriving desktop ocean! Earn gold as you work, study, type, or click, then collect marine fish, vibrant corals, and fun decorations. Draw your own fish, visit friends, and trade tank mates as you build a cozy aquarium that's uniquely yours!

apps.name: Neon Arcology
apps.short_description: A small city building game that lives in a corner of your desktop. Design each district to maximize population and income, or take a break and let the auto-builder manage things for a while. Unlock new areas as your city grows and eventually begin constructing its Arcology.

apps.name: Nick of Time: A Very Forgetful Christmas
apps.short_description: All of the power. None of the wisdom. Santa has lost his memory, and he's using his magic like a man who's never been told no. Two romances? Multiple endings? One long List.

apps.name: Night on Bald Mountain
apps.short_description: Orbit, dodge, and touch! Light up the stars in an action game built around Night on Bald Mountain!

apps.name: No Mercy
apps.short_description: A gritty bodycam-style first-person shooter where a failed coup throws the city into chaos. Fight through gang-controlled streets, uncover the truth behind your wife's disappearance, and take back what was stolen—one bullet at a time.

apps.name: No Return Address
apps.short_description: Night shift at a distribution center. Ordinary packages go forward, strange ones go to reject. Just don’t make a mistake when the boxes start containing things that should never be there.

apps.name: NOAD
apps.short_description: Noad: The Priest is a 2D action adventure game. It tells the story of a priest who begins an expedition where an unknown black substance 'Adven' flows out of the gate and cannot return beyond it. Face the truth with newcomers beyond the gate!

apps.name: Nova Weapon Store: Tidy Up
apps.short_description: Tidy up a sci-fi weapon shop after a gravity glitch leaves stock scattered across the floor. Sort 3,000+ items, including guns, magazines, drones and other supplies. Unlock helpful upgrades and fill the shop’s displays at your own pace, with no time pressure.

apps.name: NowLoadingが終わらない
apps.short_description:
Can you actually “play” this game!?
Before you can play "FINAL TALES QUEST", you must first load the game data.

apps.name: NucleMon: Eggscape
apps.short_description: NucleMon is a creature collection and creature building game where you play as a newly evolved lifeform with transformation ability. Collect and transform into various NucleMon, freely building their abilities using diverse genetic traits. Explore, battle, and and build your very own NucleMon.

apps.name: OneMore
apps.short_description:
Can you tell which definitions are fake and which aren't? 
OneMore combines traditional word-building games with rounds where you try to pick the one true definition out of four - three of them built by an AI.

apps.name: Orcs Must Be Killed (Adult RPG)
apps.short_description: Orcs Must Be Killed (Adult RPG) is a party-based role-playing game with an adult twist, featuring turn-based combat, rich storyline and animated sex scenes with sounds and a moving camera.

apps.name: Order Filled: A Trading Desk Story
apps.short_description: A stock trading sim with a story mode and a free mode. Story mode: you start as a new trader on a US desk in 2010, with a tutorial week, client orders and an evening review of your fills. Free mode: open an account, pick your stake and trade a generated market, with margin and short selling.

apps.name: Overbooked
apps.short_description: In this Roguelike deckbuilder, arrange rooms for eccentric animal guests under overbooking pressure to meet KPIs. Upgrade rooms with furniture, and squeeze in your freeloading Panda Manager at peak capacity.

apps.name: OVERSWARM
apps.short_description: Break the swarm. A neon roguelite bullet-hell where every run builds a monster: stack upgrades, sign cursed pacts, master your hull. Take it down THE DESCENT, hold THE SIEGE, outrun the void in THE DRIFT, or fly the daily Op everyone flies. No dialogue. Just you, the swarm, the void.

apps.name: Palette Panic
apps.short_description: A billiards defense game where you hit approaching enemies with balls of matching color. Mix and split colors to make the one you need, bank shots off the walls, and stop the enemies before they cross the board. Test your skills in over 100 levels.

apps.name: Path of Heaven
apps.short_description: A wildly popular idle RPG! Gaze upon your pixel warrior in combat beside the quest panel. Craft unique builds with a rich roster of classes, skills and gear, and reap boundless treasures!

apps.name: Pax Oceana
apps.short_description: A relaxing fishing JRPG. Sail the bright seas of Oceana, win rhythm-driven battles against more than 200 species, and offer your finest catches to a radiant crystal. Each offering loosens the bindings of a sealed king.

apps.name: PC JUMPS+
apps.short_description:
Drive fast. React Faster. PC Jumps is a difficult platformer where precision is everything.
Master your jumps to overcome obstacles and prove you have what it takes to reach the finish. 
Don't Forget to customize your car before driving off.

apps.name: Penknife
apps.short_description: The closer to death you are the stronger you become, Penknife is a Survival Horror where a British chav accidentally unleashes an eldritch invasion. Fight to survive with limited resources within an open, interconnected world, infested with horrifying monsters.

apps.name: PERFECT SNAP: Ultimate Jigsaw Puzzles
apps.short_description: Turn any image into a 3D jigsaw puzzle! Solve solo or with friends (co-op & PvP), display your masterpieces in a customizable 3D museum, and visit everyone else's. Personalize your character and take on the 100-level campaign, from easy puzzles all the way to 1000 pieces.

apps.name: Pigeon Advocate
apps.short_description: Defend three very suspicious pigeons in a courtroom comedy. Inspect absurd evidence, press witnesses, and turn contradictions into thunderous avian protests. Your best legal argument might be half a croissant.

apps.name: Pigs and Wolf
apps.short_description: Build. Survive. Drag your home. Lost piggies. A rolling home. Hungry wolves. Play solo or team up with friends to gather resources and survive the night in this chaotic fairy-tale survival adventure.

apps.name: Pipefall
apps.short_description: Pipefall is a fast-paced falling-block puzzle game where every piece is part of a pipeline. Connect pipes, guide the flow and keep building as the pressure rises. Play solo, cooperate with a friend or compete head-to-head in local multiplayer.

apps.name: Plagueborn
apps.short_description: Plagueborn is a 2D action roguelike where you and your allies battle through plague-ridden dungeons. Explore procedurally generated floors, master a wide arsenal of weapons, forge unique builds, and cut down relentless hordes of darkness.

apps.name: Planet Harvester
apps.short_description: Planet Harvester is a sci-fi automation and resource management sim where you deploy autonomous drones, harvest planets, transfer resources to your mothership, buy upgrades, solve bottlenecks, and expand across the galaxy.

apps.name: Post Apocalyptic Gas Station (PAGS)
apps.short_description: Run the last known gas station in the southwest in this base building colony sim. Set the fuel price, build and staff a fortified outpost, send crews into the wastes, and deal with the factions at your pumps. Weigh morale decisions against one another as you expand your empire.

apps.name: Potato Factory
apps.short_description: Stranded on Mars with a storm closing in, you need money for a rocket. Grow potatoes, sell your first batch of chips, and put your earnings into a bigger production line. Then the mutant potatoes arrive, right on schedule. What could you sell them for?

apps.name: Pray & Slay
apps.short_description: Wipe out hordes of monsters with holy magic in this action-packed incremental game. Multiply your gold with darts and grow stronger with every run. Corrupt your holy spells to unleash devastating dark powers.

apps.name: Prison Survivors
apps.short_description: You're the screws. They're the riot. Mow down hordes of inmates, evolve standard-issue gear into gloriously non-standard firepower and outlast 24 bosses in a meme-stuffed bullet heaven. Ten-minute shifts, 9 survivors to unlock, then the big choice: clock off, or stay for the Double Shift.

apps.name: Racing Season Manager
apps.short_description: Take charge of a racing team for a full season. Plan your next move, make the big decisions, and lead your team towards success.

apps.name: Rallying Call
apps.short_description: Rallying Call is a roguelike strategy game where you build your army like a deck of cards. Explore the world in search of powerful artifacts and devastating spells. Combine units and items to create unique synergies. Assemble an unstoppable army and challenge the demonic gods!

apps.name: Rance 01 + 02
apps.short_description: Embark on the classic adventure that marked the beginning of the legendary Rance series with Rance 01 and Rance 02. Witness the start to this epic tale that spans over 10 games and spin-offs and meet the brutal warrior himself as he ventures to the wealthy Kingdom of Leazas and the town of Custom.

apps.name: Reclaim Home
apps.short_description: Reclaim Home is a story-driven 2D adventure through mysterious ancient worlds. Explore forgotten ruins, uncover hidden secrets, solve challenging puzzles, and face dangers along the way as you embark on a journey to reclaim what was once yours.

apps.name: Red Dust Colony
apps.short_description: The spirit of the space race lives on in this Mars based colony sim. Mine, craft and research in order to build up your initial lander into a self sustaining colony. Keep oxygen levels high and CO₂ levels low. Discover and grow a variety of plants to balance out colonist nutrition.

apps.name: Rekisen TCG
apps.short_description:
With its signature "Rekisen Summoning" system, this snappy arcade card game offers a unique experience with 80 carefully balanced cards.
Play your favorite modes, earn gold, and open booster packs to collect cards and build custom decks.

apps.name: Rivendale
apps.short_description: Start a new life in the cozy town of Rivendale and build your own culinary business. Grow ingredients, explore the world, create unique dishes, and develop relationships with the town's residents.

apps.name: Robo Dream Party
apps.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party brawler set inside a robot's dream, where physics goes haywire. Punch, grab, and throw anything you find, ride robot vehicles, and knock your friends off the map to be the last robot standing!

apps.name: RUGGED
apps.short_description: RUGGED is first-person survival for one to four players. Fell trees, haul logs back to camp, craft tools, and hunt for food. Build a cabin on your own or host your existing world for friends through online or LAN co-op.

apps.name: Saint Hallow
apps.short_description: An nice little adventure game with a SPRINKLE of horror on top, this Cat and Mouse game is a steady paced, action oriented experience! Gather coins, find notes, and escape the claws of the Traeger Wolf. Be sure to utilize your powers, they may come in handy later.

apps.name: Save the North Pole
apps.short_description: Oh no! A snowstorm has buried Santa’s village at the North Pole! The wind blew the ornaments off the giant tree and hid them in the snow, and Christmas is tomorrow! Become an elf and team up with friends to clear the paths, dig up the ornaments and hang them on the tree. Save Christmas!

apps.name: ScareZone
apps.short_description: Build the haunted attraction of your nightmares! Design chilling walkthroughs, fill them with animatronics and actors, then watch your victims - er, guests - scream their way through your twisted creation. Grow your empire season after season and prove you have the guts to be a world-class haunter.

apps.name: SCP Tower
apps.short_description: You were hired as a ranger into National park. Your job? Taking care of Suntop Lookout. However once you get there, ceiling trapdoor is blasted open, showing continuation of Suntop Lookout. Will you enter?

apps.name: ScrapHeads
apps.short_description: Smash it all and get paid! ScrapHeads is a chaotic co-op game for up to 4 players. Scrap spaceships, mechs, and anything else that lands in your yard with ridiculous tools, explosive mayhem, and wild physics. Feed Panzarius and turn every shift into a disaster!

apps.name: SEAM VR
apps.short_description: SEAM is a VR voxel survival sandbox where your hands reshape the world. Use gravity gloves to gather resources, dig into the landscape, and build a home block by block. Explore, craft, and turn the wilderness into a place of your own.

apps.name: Sector Defense
apps.short_description: Command the last line of defense in this single-player, turn-based sci-fi roguelite. Build two Defense Platforms, craft gear from salvage, and hold your home sector against three unknown invading factions, one run at a time.

apps.name: Security Crew
apps.short_description: Security Crew is a first person co-op survival horror game for 1-6 players. As a night shift security guard stationed at abstract, high risk locations, your mission is simply to survive through the night alive.

apps.name: Selenwald
apps.short_description: Selenwald is an action roguelike RPG that combines challenging combat with strategy and resource management. Take control of random adventurers to fight and sneak your way through eldritch horrors roaming the ever changing halls of Selenwald university.

apps.name: SHADOW LINK～Two Of Me～
apps.short_description: Control a princess wielding cute fairy-tale weapons to defeat massive enemy waves in this roguelite survival action! Fight alongside a Shadow replicating your past runs. Plan your builds, position strategically, and defeat giant bosses to survive all 40 waves (approx. 20 mins)!

apps.name: Shattervein
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy card battler built around perfectly timed deflections and devastating combos. Build around Poison, blood sacrifices, Bleed, or relentless multi-hit attacks across 60 stages and five Acts. Survive Normal Mode—or test your endurance in Hell Mode, where HP carries between battles.

apps.name: Shroom Siege
apps.short_description: Battle for control of a fungus-infested Kingdom in 4v4 strategic multiplayer matches. Possess specialized insects, working together to reach a Shogun, Shrine, or achieve a Poop Victory (yes, you read that right .. Poop Victory). Shroom Siege is for both new and experienced fighters!

apps.name: Shroud of Gloom
apps.short_description: Shroud of Gloom is a point-and-click horror adventure. Investigate an old manor, gather items and clues to solve environmental puzzles and discover dark secrets. Can you uncover the mystery… and make it out alive?

apps.name: Shutter Story
apps.short_description:
Examine a family's photo album to reveal signs of the paranormal, as the horror unfolds in the house around you. 


Their fate is in your hands.

apps.name: Slop Slop
apps.short_description:
The swamp is hungry. The hut demands tribute. And you? You're just trying to survive.

Slop Slop is a co-op survival game for up to 8 players. Each day, a mysterious hut in the swamp demands a new offering of food. Fail to deliver, and… well, let's just say the swamp doesn't do eviction notices.

apps.name: Soft Ruin
apps.short_description: Soft Ruin is an Open Dungeon Exploration Game.

apps.name: SolutionWCMD
apps.short_description: Escape a bunker that has become a cage. As Vey, a corrupted drone, solve puzzles, slip past relentless enemies, and fight when hiding is no longer enough. A story-driven 2D horror adventure where warmth, humor, and fragile bonds meet something deeply wrong.

apps.name: Sort Them Socks
apps.short_description: Sort Them Socks is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 3,000 unique socks onto the correct shelves. Enjoy the satisfying process of turning a messy socks store into a perfectly organized collection at your own pace.

apps.name: Speff
apps.short_description: Run, jump, and THINK your way through a series of grisly obstacles and diabolical puzzles. 20 Levels across 5 hubs with wonderfully hand drawn environments and characters.

apps.name: Spinful
apps.short_description:
A fantasy roguelite slot-builder.
Upgrade, enhance and customize your slots into a powerful combat machine!

apps.name: Sprinkle Gnomes
apps.short_description: Sprinkle Gnomes is a cozy first-person co-op game about bringing the scorched badlands back to life. Find hidden wells, build watering automations and ride camels across the dry land until grass springs up again. Play solo or team up with friends and turn every dusty corner green.

apps.name: Story of The Needle In a Haystack
apps.short_description: A cozy co-op tidy-up game with a compelling story. Clear an old barn filled with hay, explore rooms, upgrade your tools, and sell what you collect. Team up with friends to uncover the story as you search for a tiny needle.

apps.name: Streamer Manager
apps.short_description: Start with zero followers in a tiny room. Plan each week's streams, handle live donations and on-air surprises, ride the genres on the rise, and grow an unknown streamer into a star everyone watches.

apps.name: Sweatshop 24
apps.short_description: A co-op factory game with PSX looks. You and your crew are Santa's chief elves, building toy production lines in a bunker under the North Pole. Hit his nightly quota for 24 nights straight, and pray you never meet what comes down the elevator when you miss.

apps.name: Take Care!!!
apps.short_description: A chaotic co-op pharmacy sim for 1–4 players. Serve patients, fill prescriptions, hit your quotas—and pray nobody loses it. Turn mounting stress into a resource and somehow make it to closing time!

apps.name: Tales & Duels
apps.short_description:
Tales & Duels is a deck-building roguelite with a unique combat system built around designing the order of your attacks.
Explore a broken world alongside fairy-tale heroes, collect powerful skills and gear, and defeat the villains that stand in your way.

apps.name: Temp Agency
apps.short_description:
Temp Agency is a chaotic office co-op game where you and a friend race against the clock to survive increasingly ridiculous office jobs through different levels and offices. Answer phones, deliver packages, brew coffee, and work together to keep the office running.

Or at least try to.

apps.name: Tenancy
apps.short_description: Tenancy is a roguelike deckbuilder about managing the costs, risks, and unique effects of angry little ladies so you can live off their paychecks. While tenants may be lackluster on their own, when played together they can be extorted for maximum value!

apps.name: The Corporate Nightmare
apps.short_description: Experience Tamil horror in The Corporate Nightmare. Explore Nizhal Infotech, solve puzzles, uncover corporate secrets, and survive dangerous encounters. Featuring Tamil voice acting, murder, drugs, profanity, workplace abuse, and dark humour.

apps.name: THE END: Pronton
apps.short_description: The chaotic Earth has barely regained stability, but meets a force called Poroton beyond the universe...

apps.name: The Korridor
apps.short_description: Can you survive The Korridor? Try to craft an overpowered build as you discover skills and talent trees during a run! Compliment your build by collecting lots of loot and upgrading it. Equip yourself well to face foes where sometimes raw strength is not enough…in this never ending accursed dungeon!

apps.name: The Last Banner
apps.short_description: The Last Banner is a deck-building roguelite where range decides every fight. Each card strikes only at Near, Mid or Far — step in or fall back, and read the enemy's next move. Lead three bearers through twenty cursed lands and raise the last banner.
publishers: 株式会社ワンコネクト

apps.name: The Legend of Legendaria: Where Legends are Born
apps.short_description: Four hundred years ago the sky broke. Now three townsfolk refuse a warlord his star-tithe, and the long road east begins. A hex-grid tactics RPG in the spirit of an eighties fantasy film: forty heroes to recruit, dragons to raise, and death that sticks.

apps.name: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
apps.short_description: The Road of Dust and Sorrow is a tense, story-driven pixel art horror inspired by ’90s classics. Survive a world gone wrong and protect what matters most: your daughter.

apps.name: TheDeskFishTank
apps.short_description:
A desktop aquarium game where you can create multiple aquariums of different sizes on your desktop.
Interact with them using your mouse during your free time for a unique experience.

apps.name: Timeless Heart VR
apps.short_description: Timeless Heart VR is a story-driven VR action adventure. Join Lycaena in battle, wield different weapons, and use your Chain Claw to race through four kingdoms frozen on the eve of ruin. Only by defying fate again can you reach the final answer.

apps.name: Titheborn
apps.short_description: Descend into a traditional turn-based roguelike of deadly dungeons, strange heroes, and sixteen demanding gods. Create your adventurer, recover ancient Orbs, and survive to tithe your treasures. Compete in the one-shot Daily Delve, uncover fallen players' graves, or watch and bless their adventures.

apps.name: Too Deep, Too Greedily
apps.short_description: A short incremental game about mining so deep and so greedily that your hubris incurs the wrath of the deep ones. Mine to collect ore, defeat monsters to collect gems, and upgrade your miners to be dangerously good at their jobs.

apps.name: Topica
apps.short_description: You're stranded on an Island. Build a house, explore the open world, hunt animals, plant food, and much more. Start your new life far from civilization and uncover the island's secrets.

apps.name: Torizon Telecom
apps.short_description:
Torizon Telecom is a text-based FPS game set in a vast world composed entirely of text.
“Telecom”—a  world where everything is text. “Telecom”... 

But does any other world exist beyond “Telecom”...? Or is “Telecom” the only one that exists...?

apps.name: Tower of Lunaria
apps.short_description: Leap between platforms, dodge enemy attacks, and build an arsenal of auto-firing weapons in Tower of Lunaria, a 2D action roguelite. Choose from 18 climbers, combine up to six weapon types, and challenge a 30-floor expedition or climb endlessly as darkness rises below.

apps.name: Tún
apps.short_description: Tún is a relaxing puzzle game in which you grow a garden at your own pace. Fulfill requests, expand your garden, decorate it as you see fit, and adopt cats. There is no "game over" and the game never becomes too stressful.

apps.name: UltiLoot
apps.short_description: UltiLoot is a short, relaxing incremental RPG inspired by classic dungeon crawlers. Watch your party battle through dungeon floors, collect loot, and grow stronger. Better gear, stronger heroes, deeper dungeons.

apps.name: Uncivilized
apps.short_description: A short-form empire building strategy game. Explore the planet and grow your colony, while attempting to negotiate with the many characterful rival factions. Make friends, break allegiances, or just drop nukes on them.

apps.name: UNCRACKED
apps.short_description: Crack your enemies with an arsenal of weapons and various tactics in this 2D egg-splosive, gore-filled, yet kid-friendly action platformer, teeming with splattering yolk and shattering eggshels and survive the fierce cage wars.

apps.name: Under A Groove
apps.short_description:
'Under A Groove' is a rhythm game that's fun just to watch, even if you're only playing the music video.

A stylish rhythm action game where visuals and music sync perfectly—simple to play, deeply satisfying to master.

apps.name: Under The Map
apps.short_description: A Horror Survival Game where you enter a backroom-style area trying to fight off entities and escape the many many levels. Will you dare to play?

apps.name: UniversiaTCG
apps.short_description: UniversiaTCG is a strategy game, based around a digital trading card game with solo campaigns, and casual or ranked 1v1, 2v2, and 4 player free-for-all game modes.

apps.name: Unlimited Maid Works
apps.short_description: A roguelike sandbox where you manage entire households as a maid. Serve unique masters, build your maid with powerful abilities, and compete for the perfect run. Juggle interconnected systems, shape each home around your playstyle, and find your own ways to keep increasingly demanding masters happy.

apps.name: Upwind
apps.short_description:
An immersive land sailing adventure where you master the wind to explore scarred lands and the remnants of lost civilizations, piecing together how humanity’s bond with nature was broken.
Customize your land yacht and learn to navigate storms, calms, and shifting winds across a wind ruled world.

apps.name: VeilWalker
apps.short_description: Veil Walker is an ARPG, where a rift between realms has fractured the veil of reality, spilling forth a malevolent force that corrupts all it touches. As a Veil Walker you hunt down any corrupted, either alone or with others, while at the same time building up your own skills and abilities.

apps.name: Verdant 森の射手
apps.short_description: Turn one arrow into a storm. Dodge attacks, scoop up gold, and build a bow that fires piercing, ricocheting volleys in this top-down incremental action game. Choose from three archers and fight your way through five areas, one short round at a time.

apps.name: Veyrith Law
apps.short_description: Congratulations on becoming a lawyer at the Veyrith Law!

apps.name: Village Slut Transformation
apps.short_description: An adult slow-burn 🔥 visual novel about an innocent girl’s gradual descent — reflected in her changing appearance, mindset, behavior, and the relationships she builds along the way 💋

apps.name: Wall Punch: Escape The Walls Simulator
apps.short_description: Break through 50,000 bricks. Time to escape the walls. Punch your way to freedom! Break through walls, punch out the walls and escape prison one punch at a time! Smash through tougher walls, discover new areas, and become the ultimate wall-breaking machine in WALL PUNCH: ESCAPE THE WALLS SIMULATOR

apps.name: War of Light: Liberation of Aetherquill
apps.short_description: A 2.5D dark-fantasy action RPG with roguelike builds and a multi-ending story. Choose your hero, face unpredictable battles, draft items and equipment, and summon Roundtable allies. Shape Aetherquill’s fate through your decisions. Play solo or in two-player local co-op.

apps.name: WARONOMY
apps.short_description: Waronomy is a turn-based fantasy strategy conquest wargame set in a medieval magic world, where strategy is everything: raise armies, empower heroes, forge elite stacks, and annihilate rival warlords until every castle on the map is yours.

apps.name: WASTE STAR: RECLAMATION
apps.short_description: Deploy a salvage mech squad, collect alloy, and build permanent upgrades. Advance through the campaign, complete tracked contracts, and unlock escalating tactical operations and an endless roguelike defense route.

apps.name: WeirdBus
apps.short_description: One bus. Four wheels. A whole lot of bad decisions. Share control of an uncooperative bus, rescue flying passengers and cross cities, canyons, ice and swamps on the way to a megatower roof. Play solo or argue your way to the finish with up to three friends.

apps.name: Why Does the Ball Fall?
apps.short_description: An idle and clicker game about dropping balls, over and over. Hit a goal hole and the ball rolls one lane deeper; miss and it is gone. Spend coins to seal holes, widen the goals and unlock fruit and animal balls, then keep descending lanes that go on forever.

apps.name: Wild Margins
apps.short_description: A colony simulator set in a procedurally generated fantasy world.  Play as one of six different races, as you expand your settlement, defend it from your foes and explore the Wild Margins, with seamless drop in and drop out co-op multiplayer with up to four of your friends.

apps.name: windowcat
apps.short_description: A cat that lives on your desktop. It walks the taskbar, naps on your windows and sleeps in a bed that opens onto its house. Make your own cats, and have friends' cats over.

apps.name: Witch Potions - Craft of Lust
apps.short_description:
Witch Potion: Craft of Lust is a potion-making simulator with elements of a visual novel, mini-
games, and hot erotic content. The game offers not only an engaging story and vibrant artwork but
also animated cutscenes where you don’t just watch but actively participate in the action!

apps.name: Witches Grove
apps.short_description: Pick a fighter, train them up and send them into the Grand Rumpus! Buy techniques and potions between rounds, weather a witch's wild spells and race through the Grove Games. Twelve quirky fighters, countless builds, one Champion's Wish. How far can you take them?

apps.name: Woods Of War
apps.short_description: Build your deck and turn your tree into an impenetrable fortress against the onslaught of increasingly powerful enemies.

apps.name: XENOH: DYNAMIC BOUT
apps.short_description: An over-the-top, bone-crunching 2D fighting game where thirteen larger-than-life fighters vie for supremacy! Dash Counters, Crash Hits, and one-button special actions deliver classic, fast, and fun arcade fighting action!

apps.name: YAZAN: Lost Child
apps.short_description: YAZAN is a 2D psychological anomaly game. Navigate a looping valley, inspect your surroundings for what doesn't belong, and turn back or press forward to make ten correct decisions and escape the loop.

apps.name: You're My Favorite Person
apps.short_description: Spend time with your new best FRIEND! Have fun as it takes you into digital worlds to explore, solve puzzles, and collect Perfect Stars! After all, it knows what's best! ...It knows what's best. IT K͜N҉O̵WS W̷HA̴T͜͞'͜S̨ ̵B̧̨̛͟E̸̡S̕͏̢͢T̸̀͢͝.̴̷̸͝  ̵̧͢͝͠ ̶̧́͡ ̷̕͘

apps.name: Yuzan's Drive: First Gear
apps.short_description: A comic-book style racing game where you start in neighborhood street races and work your way up to the legends. Race on circuits, rally stages and city streets, spend your prize money on parts in the garage, and beat rivals whose names might sound a little familiar.

apps.name: [Room Escape] Two World
apps.short_description: In a world of nothing but 0s and 1s, a robot gained a 'self'.

apps.name: ドアを選んでください : 24 HOURS BEHIND THE DOOR
apps.short_description:
