Two doors stand before you. One leads to a mostly safe room, the other to a deadly one. You have just 10 seconds to choose, then 24 hours to survive inside.

A yellow room, a festival shrine, a gigantic approaching face... Explore 100 surreal spaces in this bite-sized liminal horror game.

apps.name: ロロりんご♪－オオカミさんと、おとぎのパズル－
apps.short_description:
Make music with apples in a world of fairy tales.
Connect different kinds of apples with a single stroke to create chains and complete challenges.
Play puzzles like little pieces of sheet music, and wander through familiar stories.
But something is strange… the characters are turning into wolves…?

apps.name: 万剑之残破修仙界
apps.short_description: "The Broken Cultivation World of Ten Thousand Swords" is a portrait‑mode wuxia single‑player game from an indie developer. Featuring gorgeous combat visuals, its idle‑style gameplay focuses on item gathering. Every idle grind prepares for thrilling high‑damage bursts in turn‑based xianxia battles.

apps.name: 元メスガキギャルとカウントダウンJOI VR
apps.short_description:
Enjoy a variety of erotic scenarios, such as being told to masturbate by a gal or being teased by her.
Features multiple scenarios and multiple endings.
NPC reactions change based on the player’s actions,
offering a high level of interactivity that you can’t experience in erotic videos.

apps.name: 四面楚歌
apps.short_description: "Four Directions" is a turn-based strategy game that features a rotatable Rubik's Cube chessboard. It cleverly incorporates mechanical tasks and card skills, allowing players to activate mechanisms on the chessboard map to confront enemies head-on.

apps.name: 图标塔防 / Icon Tower Defense
apps.short_description: This is a minimalist-style tower defense game that is easy-going and relaxing, with a moderate level of difficulty. Build your tower formations to fend off enemies. It also supports online multiplayer, allowing you to team up and experience an unprecedented level of tower defense fun!

apps.name: 夏凜銀幣之庭
apps.short_description: Rinora's Silvercoin Garden is a casual idle fantasy coin pusher game. Choose relaxed idle mode or light roguelite mode, trigger chain rewards, collect treasures, and enjoy the Silvercoin Garden at your own pace.

apps.name: 失序的我与乐园
apps.short_description: This is an adventure that takes place in an amusement park. Players will explore strange scenes, meet mysterious companions, and uncover the truth behind the 'Disorderly Park' program through turn-based battles and story choices.

apps.name: 奴隷市場
apps.short_description: Defeat monsters and clear dungeons to advance. Yuke and his companions visit a town's black market, where many slaves are forced into sexual servitude and labor. Yuke decides to earn money in dungeons to buy the slaves.

apps.name: 感染½ INFECT½
apps.short_description: 《Infect½》is a Cthulhu-themed group portrait micro-horror AVG, players can control a total of seven characters in the game to advance the story. As members of the last remaining human settlement, as you explore, you slowly uncover the truth that led to the beginning of all this catastrophe...

apps.name: 我们不需要很麻烦很累就可以变强！
apps.short_description: After being cast out of your sect, you decide to grow stronger your own way. This idle cultivation game combines automatic combat, equipment progression, and combat skill builds. Train in twelve classes, refine it to higher tiers as you face hordes of monsters and powerful bosses.

apps.name: 杀个痛快
apps.short_description: A clicker incremental game where every swing fuels your growth. Hold to attack, cut through monsters, and turn your earnings into lasting power. Go from struggling against a single foe to sweeping through crowds. How far will you get this time?

apps.name: 渊生 ABYSSAL
apps.short_description: Hunt, evolve and build your own monster in a dark 2D ecosystem. Drag organs onto your body, time your evolution for a full-health comeback, and grow from one cell into a colony. Break out of the petri dish or chase survival records on Steam’s global Endless leaderboard.

apps.name: 烘焙方块
apps.short_description: 《Baked Blocks》 is a single-player grid-based puzzle game with an animal cookie theme. It features 210 puzzles across seven chapters, 30 of which have two or three different ways to solve them, allowing you to create different finished photos from the same box of cookies.

apps.name: 番長女友 魔戀
apps.short_description:
Once, delinquent girl boss Maren ruled with an iron fist.
But in a new town ruled by cunning rivals, can she seize the top again and protect her days with Ren?
A story-driven JRPG featuring exploration and branching endings.

apps.name: 睿闻三国志・说客天下
apps.short_description: Powered by offline local AI, this Three Kingdoms dialogue simulator lets you roleplay as Liu Bei, Zhuge Liang and Guan Yu. Relive six classic scenes and reshape history through free, flexible conversations.

apps.name: 神奇的知识又增加了！
apps.short_description: A knowledge Q&A party game with Steam Workshop support! Featuring hundreds of quirky, mind-bending, and bizarre questions—from everyday facts to counterintuitive trivia and pure luck challenges. Play online with your friends to find out who the true "know-it-all" is!

apps.name: 種も仕掛けも思い出も
apps.short_description:
This is a card-based adventure game. Interact with a girl trapped inside a playing card.
The girl has lost her memory. Her memories are scattered and hidden within the pictures on the cards...
In this card game based on "FreeCell," collect the cards and help the girl regain her memories.

apps.name: 空降恋人（A Sudden Girlfriend）
apps.short_description: A Sudden Girlfriend is a galgame centered around solving practice questions. In the game, you play as a high school senior who is obsessed with solving practice problems. You become involved in a series of heartwarming stories with a beautiful girl who suddenly appears in your life.

apps.name: 萌塔物语
apps.short_description: Monster girls are adorable—collect them all! Defeat monsters, possess their bodies, or capture them for your Body Vault. Switch forms to conquer the tower, then fuse, evolve, and teach skills to grow stronger bodies. Hunt rare, mutated, and prismatic variants. Start with a tower. Take every body!

apps.name: 记忆之境：牵绊
apps.short_description: This game is a maze exploration RPG that combines features such as strategic combat, puzzle-solving adventure, collectibles, and emotional storylines to provide an engaging gaming experience with beautiful scenery.

apps.name: 锯刃之心 Sawheart
apps.short_description: SAWHEART is a third-person survival action game. You play as Xi, who wakes in an unfamiliar room to find the streets outside packed with the infected — and all you have to do is survive what is left of Tidewatch.

apps.name: 雜魚都市
apps.short_description:
A fast-paced 2D cyberpunk side-scrolling action game. Control a protagonist with a massive cannon dashing through a corporate city. Master 8-way aiming, bullet management, and maneuvers to defeat enemies and loot riches.
Side-Scrolling Dash × Cannon Bombardment × Overthrowing the Elite!

apps.name: 雪楔——无尽序曲与终末之歌
apps.short_description: In this romance visual novel, you play as a traveler from an ancient land, living an easy life abroad with childhood friends. However, you begin to have recurring dreams of pure white... As time passes, the dreams start to reflect reality, slowly unveiling the world's truth.
publishers: 洛阳轻羽网络科技有限公司

apps.name: Demonherd Dungeon Soundtrack
apps.short_description: This is additional content for Demonherd Dungeon, but it does not include the base game.

apps.name: Hunt: Showdown 1896 – Port Sulphur Band – The Testament
apps.short_description: The package contains The Testament – a brand new song written exclusively for the event – and Make Them Bleed – the namesake of the event’s first Community Event. This includes both mp3s and high-resolution audio files.

apps.name: John Carpenter's Toxic Commando Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Step into a retro-futuristic hellscape with the original John Carpenter's Toxic Commando soundtrack. Experience darksynth horror through music crafted by John Carpenter, Fractal Edge Music, and Saber Interactive.

apps.name: OVERSWARM Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Sixteen tracks from OVERSWARM's live synth engine, bounced straight from the game's own code: trance, drum and bass and void-ambient, from the galaxy themes to the Void Sovereign's devoured anthem. 320 kbps MP3, plus the lossless FLAC masters as an optional download.

apps.name: Party Hard OST
apps.short_description: Get the Original Soundtrack for Party Hard

apps.name: WUCHANG: Fallen Feathers Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Experience the essence of WUCHANG: Fallen Feathers through the captivating soundtrack featuring 45 original compositions that echo its mystery and intensity.
